newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian share index holds steady in busy trade.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian share index holds steady in busy trade.

text.p: The Nigerian share index closed little changed in busy Tuesday trading as oil, food and cement shares closed higher but performance was patchy amongst bankers and brewers.
The all-share index closed at 6,524.18 from 6,524.00 on Monday.
Nestle Foods rose 60 kobo to 32.00 naira on good recent half year results.
Unipetrol and National Oil were each 50 kobo higher at 41.00 naira and 33.00 naira respectively.
Ashaka Cement closed 50 kobo up at 18.00 naira. West African Portland Cement gained 40 kobo to end at 33.00 naira. Benue Cement rose 20 kobo to 6.45 naira.
Pulled down by worse than expected first half results, then up on expectations of better future performance conglomerate Lever Brothers closed five kobo up at 25.65 naira.
FSB International Bank dropped 10 kobo to end at 4.90 naira while Guaranty Trust Bank notched 13 kobo to 13.75 naira.
UAC was down 40 kobo to 10.40 naira, with little interest shown in large volumes on the market.
Nigerian Breweries shares too closed eight kobo lower at 12.20 naira for the same reason.
Dunlop shares dropped 10 kobo to 11.70 naira.
